meta.description: Add WhatsApp Business Cloud API channel via Chat SDK. Official Meta API.

copy.tagline: 集成 WhatsApp 云 API 到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 WhatsApp 消息功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate WhatsApp Cloud API into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add WhatsApp messaging to your application

howto.what: 安装后，NanoClaw 会新增 WhatsApp 通道：复制适配器、注册通道、安装固定版本依赖并运行构建和测试。配置 Meta 凭据后，即可通过官方 API 收发 WhatsApp 一对一消息。
howto.when: 当用户要求接入 WhatsApp Business Cloud API、把 NanoClaw 连到 WhatsApp，或运行此技能添加通道时触发。执行时会复制适配器、注册通道并安装依赖。

say.text: 把 NanoClaw 接到 WhatsApp Cloud API 上。
say.note: 技能会复制适配器、注册通道并安装依赖。

say.text: 请按 add-whatsapp-cloud 添加 WhatsApp，然后跑测试。
say.note: 会安装固定版本依赖并运行构建测试验证。

howto.what_en: Adds a WhatsApp channel to NanoClaw: copies adapter, registers channel, installs pinned dependency, runs build/tests. With Meta credentials, it exchanges 1:1 WhatsApp messages via official API.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to connect NanoClaw to WhatsApp Business Cloud API or to add this channel. It then copies the adapter, registers the channel, and installs the dependency.

say_en.text: Please add a WhatsApp channel by running the add-whatsapp-cloud skill.
say_en.note: Copies adapter, registers channel, asks for Meta credentials.

say_en.text: Connect NanoClaw to the WhatsApp Cloud API.
say_en.note: Copies adapter, registers channel, installs dependencies.

say_en.text: Run add-whatsapp-cloud to add WhatsApp and then run the tests.
say_en.note: Installs the pinned dependency and runs build/tests.
